description: Sea surface temperature forecast at a coastal or offshore point in northern European waters (including UK coasts): the temperature now, the range over the next 24 hours, and hourly values. For open-water swimmers, surfers, divers and anglers. Source: MET Norway Oceanforecast 2.0 (model sea temperature at the nearest model sea point). Not a measured buoy reading; points on land or outside the model area return no rows. Needs lat and lon: for a UK place name or postcode, get coordinates from geocode or postcode_lookup first. (cost: 1 credit)

lat.description: number, required, latitude of a sea point in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude of a sea point in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

name: sea_temperature
